shortDescription: Manage OpenStack Server Groups (Affinity Groups) in Waldur.

options.name: api_url
options.description: Fully qualified URL to the API.

options.name: customer
options.description: The name or UUID of the parent customer for filtering.

options.name: description
options.description: Description This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: interval
options.description: The interval in seconds for polling the async action status.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the OpenStack server group. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: policy
options.description: affinity — all instances are placed on the same hypervisor. anti-affinity — all instances are placed on different hypervisors. soft-affinity — instances are placed on the same hypervisor if possible, but not enforced. soft-anti-affinity — instances are placed on different hypervisors if possible, but not enforced. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: project
options.description: The name or UUID of the parent project for filtering.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present or absent.

options.name: tenant
options.description: The parent tenant name or UUID.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for the async action to complete.

options.name: uuid
options.description: The UUID of the OpenStack server group. Use this to identify a specific resource for modification or deletion.

options.name: wait
options.description: A boolean value that defines whether to wait for the async action to complete.
